intro: Experience restful luxury with our Goldust bed. A bold headboard, metallic details, and smart storage blend tradition with modern convenience—crafted for the way you live.

features.title: Refined walnut finish
features.text: A rich walnut tone brings warmth and depth to your room, giving your bedroom a calm and sophisticated look.

features.title: Statement headboard
features.text: The oversized headboard with subtle metallic accents adds a touch of drama and elegance to your space.

features.title: Solid Sheesham strength
features.text: Crafted from durable Sheesham wood, your bed is built to last—strong, sturdy, and ready for everyday use.

features.title: Effortless storage access
features.text: Lift the mattress panel without removing the mattress to access spacious storage—no stress, no hassle.

features.title: Termite-proof by nature
features.text: Seasoned for resistance, your bed stays beautiful and bug-free with minimal maintenance required.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
